title: Adaptive Commitment Funnel: tiered deliverable gating and reserve staffing playbook
creator: Amina Patel
description:
Summary:
Build a repeatable playbook — the "Adaptive Commitment Funnel" — that gives PMs and Eng leads a lightweight gating process and a pre-authorized staffing reserve for mid-cycle surges. The goal is to reduce emergency rework, improve predictability of committed scope, and make scope-cuts explicit and low-friction.

Background / problem statement:
- We routinely under/over-commit between planning and mid-cycle execution. Decisions to trim scope are often ad hoc late in the cycle and lack a predictable staffing fallback, causing morale churn and quality regressions.
- Current cycle-triage relies on manual Slack threads and spreadsheet gymnastics with inconsistent outcomes across teams.

What this ticket delivers:
1) A 3-tier gating framework (Go / Guardrail / Contain) with clear entry/exit criteria for features and sub-features.
2) Role-level reserve bands (Core, Shadow, Surge) described per discipline (backend, infra, frontend, QA, SRE) with a pre-approved activation protocol.
3) Soft-scope triggers and decision matrix for automated recommendations (e.g., if commit drift > 12% or blocker-days > 3, recommend a scope freeze + surge activation).
4) Templates and checklists (PRD acceptance, rollback criteria, test coverage floor) plus a PM playbook page and a Console dashboard widget to visualize active commitments vs. reserve capacity.

Success metrics (target by end of pilot):
- Reduce late-scope cuts occurring after week 2 by 45%.
- Decrease unplanned cross-team handoffs caused by scope churn by 30%.
- Keep average role utilization within the planned band +/- 10% across the pilot teams.

Out of scope:
- Automated staffing reassignments (this is human-driven initially).
- Billing or payroll changes.

Milestones / implementation plan:
- Week 0 (Jan 25 - Feb 1): Draft framework and decision matrix; alignment with Eng leads and People Ops.
- Week 1 (Feb 2 - Feb 8): Produce playbook doc, PM templates, and an initial dashboard spec for Console.
- Week 2 (Feb 9 - Feb 15): Pilot with two cross-functional squads; collect telemetry and qualitative feedback.
- Week 3 (Feb 16 - Feb 28): Iterate and prepare rollout guidance for 3 additional squads; integrate with cycle capacity tracker and retrospective templates.

Stakeholders / approvers:
- PM: Amina Patel (owner)
- Eng leads: Diego Ramos (assignee), Priya Shah (infra), Marcus Lee (runtime)
- People Ops: Claire Nguyen (staffing policy)
- DX/Design: Lina Moreno (playbook UX)

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Teams view the funnel as additional process overhead.
  Mitigation: Keep templates < 2 pages, emphasize pre-approved surge credits and limit activations per cycle.
- Risk: Misalignment on what counts as "surge" capacity.
  Mitigation: Define role-level examples and run a 60-minute calibration workshop.

Rollout notes:
- Pilot squads will get 1 hour onboarding + a quick checklist used at end-of-planning.
- Console dashboard will show an aggregated "Commitment Health" metric and a per-role reserve consumption meter.
